messages.subject: Project Kestrel - Subscription Agreement (first draft)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Oliver, Deepa,

Please find attached the first draft of the Subscription Agreement for Project Kestrel. Key commercial terms (2,000,000 Series B shares at £10.00, £20m) follow the signed term sheet. The Investor Rights Agreement and amended Articles will follow this week.

We look forward to your mark-up.

Kind regards,
James
James Osei  |  Senior Associate

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
